_about: One line about each command, and the part of the manual it belongs to. tools/docs/reference.js joins these with package.json to write the command and key references.

org.menu: Every org command in one searchable list, the ones that fit where the cursor is first, each with its key.
org.tableMenu: The same menu as Org: Menu (kept for older key bindings).
org.openPractice: Opens a practice org file to try Tab, tables and links on.
org.cycle: On a heading: fold it, then show its children, then everything under it (org's Tab).
org.globalCycle: The whole file: top headings only, then every heading, then everything (org's Shift+Tab).
org.moveSubtreeUp: Moves the heading, and everything under it, above the heading before it.
org.moveSubtreeDown: Moves the heading, and everything under it, below the heading after it.
org.promoteSubtree: Takes a star off the heading and every heading under it.
org.demoteSubtree: Adds a star to the heading and every heading under it.
org.doPromote: Takes a star off this heading only.
org.doDemote: Adds a star to this heading only.
org.insertHeadingRespectContent: A new heading at this level, after the current entry's content.
org.insertSubheading: A new heading one level down, under the current one.
org.sort: Sorts what the cursor is in: table rows, a list, or the headings under a heading.
org.selectNode: Selects the block or entry the cursor is in.
org.narrowToSubtree: Opens the subtree in a tab of its own; saving it writes it back (org's C-x n s).
org.updateStatistics: Works out every [2/5] and [40%] statistics cookie in the file again.
org.tabHandler: Folds or unfolds the heading or drawer on the cursor's line.
org.addDoWhatIMean: Does the obvious thing: a new heading, checkbox or list item like the one the cursor is on, or follows a link.
org.butterfly: M-x butterfly. An xkcd joke; harmless.
org.incrementContext: Steps the date under the cursor forward a day, or the heading's keyword to the next one.
org.decrementContext: Steps the date under the cursor back a day, or the heading's keyword to the one before.
org.chooseTodo: Picks the heading's TODO keyword from a list.
org.insertTag: Adds a tag to the heading.
org.insertProjectTag: Adds the project tag to the heading.
org.insertWorkTag: Adds the work tag to the heading.
org.chooseTodoView: Opens one of your org.todoConfigs TODO lists, from the orgs server.
org.setMarker: Puts one of your marker tags (org.markers) on this heading, taking it off any other.
org.jumpToMarker: Goes to the heading carrying a marker tag.
org.toggleCheckbox: Ticks or unticks the checkbox on the line.
org.insertCheckbox: A new checkbox item under this one.
org.insertCheckboxSummary: Adds a [n/m] summary to the list's parent.
org.recalcCheckboxSummary: Works out the checkbox summary above the cursor again.
org.recalcAllCheckboxSummaries: Works out every checkbox summary in the file again.
org.updateNumberedList: Numbers the numbered list under the cursor again, from 1.
org.appendNumberedList: Adds the next item to a numbered list.
org.insertPropertyDrawer: Adds a :PROPERTIES: drawer to the heading, if it has none.
org.insertLogbookDrawer: Adds a :LOGBOOK: drawer to the heading, if it has none.
org.insertProperty: Sets a property in the heading's drawer.
org.insertCreated: Adds :CREATED: with the time now to the heading's drawer.
org.insertCustomId: Adds a :CUSTOM_ID: made from the title, for [[#id]] links.
org.insertId: Adds an :ID: (a uuid); [[id:...]] links find the heading wherever it moves.
org.columnView: The file's headings and their properties as an editable table, with totals.
org.literal: Turns the line into fixed-width text (": " in front of it).
org.reformat: Has the orgs server rewrite the file the way org writes it.
org.gotoNextCell: Aligns the table and goes to the next cell, making a row past the last one.
org.gotoPreviousCell: Aligns the table and goes to the previous cell.
org.nextRow: Goes down a row in the same column, making a row at the end or over a rule.
org.formatUnderCursor: Aligns the table under the cursor.
org.moveRowUp: Swaps the row with the one above.
org.moveRowDown: Swaps the row with the one below.
org.moveColLeft: Swaps the column with the one to its left.
org.moveColRight: Swaps the column with the one to its right.
org.addColLeft: A new column to the left.
org.addColRight: A new column to the right.
org.insertSeparatorAndMove: A rule under the row, and on to the row below it.
org.copyFieldDown: Copies the cell into the row below (an empty one takes the cell above); numbers count up.
org.splitCell: Moves the text after the cursor into a new row below.
org.joinRows: Joins the row below onto this one, cell by cell.
org.createTable: A new table of the size you ask for.
org.execTable: Recalculates the table's #+TBLFM: formulas (through the orgs server).
org.execAllTables: Recalculates every table with formulas in the file.
org.editTableFormula: Writes, changes or removes the formula for the cell under the cursor.
org.sortTable: Sorts the rows between rules by the cursor's column.
org.sumTableColumn: Adds up the column and copies the total.
org.convertToTable: Turns the selection, or the paragraph, into a table.
org.pasteAsTable: Pastes the clipboard's csv or tab separated text as a table.
org.importTable: Reads a csv or tsv file into a table.
org.insertTableName: Inserts the #+NAME: of a table, for remote().
org.gotoTable: Goes to any table the orgs server knows.
org.plotTable: Charts the table beside the editor, following #+PLOT:.
org.setupVimTableKeys: Adds <leader>t... mappings for the table commands to VSCodeVim.
org.tableModeOn: Turns the table keys (Tab, Enter, Alt+arrows) back on.
org.tableModeOff: Turns the table keys off, so they do what they do outside tables.
org.randomTableRow: Inserts a random row of a named table.
org.openLink: Follows the link under the cursor (urls in the browser).
org.storeLink: Remembers the heading you are under, to link to with Insert Link.
org.insertLink: Inserts a link to any heading in the workspace, a file or a web address.
org.showBacklinks: Every link to the heading the cursor is under.
org.insertFootnote: Inserts the next numbered footnote and takes you to write it; on a footnote, goes between it and its note.
org.insertTimestamp: A menu of timestamps: today or now, active or inactive, or from the calendar.
org.scheduleNode: SCHEDULED: on the heading, picked from the calendar.
org.deadlineNode: DEADLINE: on the heading, picked from the calendar.
org.timestampNode: A timestamp picked from the calendar.
org.clockin: Starts the clock on the heading the cursor is under.
org.clockactive: Says whether the clock is running, and on what.
org.jumpToClock: Goes to the heading the clock is running on.
org.updateclock: Works out the total of the CLOCK: line under the cursor again.
org.updateAllClocks: Works out every CLOCK: line's total in the file again.
org.startTimer: A pomodoro or a timer of your own in the status bar; clocks in on the heading.
org.stopTimer: Stops the timer (and the clock it started).
org.timerMenu: Pause, add time to or stop the running timer.
org.clock.open: Goes to a heading from the Clock view.
org.prevDayPage: Opens the day page before this one.
org.nextDayPage: Opens the day page after this one.
org.showDayPageToday: Opens today's day page, making it if need be.
org.run: Runs what is at the cursor: a table's formulas, a source block, a #+CALL:, inline code or a dynamic block.
org.execBlock: Runs the block at the cursor (the same as Run At Cursor).
org.runAllBlocks: Runs every source block, call and inline code in the file.
org.updateAllDynamicBlocks: Refreshes every #+BEGIN: dynamic block in the file.
org.tangle: Writes out the blocks with a :tangle header.
org.refile: Moves the subtree (or the selected ones) under any heading.
org.copySubtree: Copies the subtree under any heading, leaving it where it is too.
org.archive: Sends the subtree to its archive.
org.archiveAllDone: Archives every finished subtree in the file, after asking.
org.createJira: Makes a Jira ticket from the heading (if the server has Jira set up).
org.capture: Opens a capture page for one of your templates.
org.quickCapture: Captures one line from anywhere, through a server template.
org.showAgenda: Opens worg's agenda (or the classic one, with org.agendaView).
org.agenda.reschedule: Schedules an agenda entry for another day.
org.agenda.clockIn: Clocks in on an agenda entry.
org.export: Exports the file as html, pdf, LaTeX, slides or markdown, next to it.
org.exportSubtree: Exports just the subtree the cursor is in.
org.latexExport: Opens the file's LaTeX beside it.
org.showWeb: Previews the file as a web page, following the file you are in.
org.showReveal: Previews the file as Reveal.js slides.
org.showImpress: Previews the file as Impress.js slides.
org.showGantt: A Gantt chart of the headings a query finds.
org.showMindMap: A mind map of the headings a query finds.
org.showMediaPanel: The pictures and LaTeX in the subtree you are in, drawn beside the editor.
org.habits: Your habits, due ones first; pick one to mark it done today, or take it back.
org.encryptHeading: Encrypts the heading's body with gpg.
org.decryptHeading: Shows, or decrypts in the file, an encrypted heading.
org.openAttachment: Opens one of the heading's attachments.
org.fileHistory: Compares the file with an earlier commit.
org.newFile: Starts a new org file, from a template if you like.
org.searchFiles: Searches the text of every org file as you type.
org.searchThisFile: Searches the text of this file as you type.
org.connectToOrgs: Checks that the orgs server answers.
org.login: Logs in to the orgs server.
org.logout: Logs out of the orgs server.
org.connectionMenu: Log in or out, check the server, open worg or change its address.
